properties.description:
The `dangling_reference` HEAL rule walks every property the schema declares `node_ref` and reports a non-empty value naming no node — independent of the carrier's degree, its status, and any ruling that parks it.

DELIBERATELY NAMED AFTER ITS SIBLING `cap:a-node-attached-to-nothing-is-reported-whatever-its-type`, because it closes the same shape of hole one axis over. That capability's promise was "whatever its type"; the unstated qualifier was "and whatever its degree", which was false. Measured 2026-08-29 on reflow2's own graph: of nine dangling `subject_id` values, seven were reported and two were silent, and the two silent ones were exactly the two carrying edges — because `orphan_node` fires only when a subject "resolves to no node AND it carries no edge either".

TWO NEAR-MATCHES WERE OFFERED AND BOTH READ; THE THREE ARE DIFFERENT KINDS OF RECORD, which is why this is its own node. `fact:a-dangling-reference-is-only-detected-when-the-node-is-also-edgeless` is the MEASUREMENT of the hole and keeps its own numbers and scope caveat. `chg:a-dangling-reference-is-detected-on-its-own-terms` is the EVENT that changed the code, and dates it. This is the standing capability the design now claims — the thing that stays true after the event is history and the measurement is superseded.

THREE PROPERTIES IT HOLDS, each a decision rather than a default:

① SELF-LIMITING BY POPULATION. It reports how many declared node REFERENCES it walked, not how many nodes exist. A schema declaring no `node_ref` property gives `examined: 0`, and the sweep's starved-rule note then says in words that this rule had nothing to examine — so a clean result can never be read as a clean design. Counting nodes would have claimed thousands examined while inspecting none.

② ONE DEFECT, ONE FINDING. It runs before the zero-degree rule and that rule skips whatever it reports, so an edgeless node with a broken pointer arrives once. Reporting it twice would put one fault in two vocabularies suggesting two different repairs — the duplication BL-176 measured a field reporter stopping work over.

③ NOT SUPPRESSIBLE BY A PARK, unlike its sibling. `GOVERNED_BY ruling: parks` says a node is deliberately attached to nothing, which is a state a person can hold. Nobody can decide that a record is ABOUT a node the design does not have, so a park must not silence this.

It proposes no repair and says why: choosing the intended target is a judgement, a near-spelling match is not evidence, and a tool guessing would fabricate the same class of false record the rule exists to find. `propose_heal` reports it as a skipped operation carrying that reason, rather than emitting the generation stub every other non-repairable category emits.
properties.name: A reference that resolves to nothing is reported on its own terms, whatever else the node is attached to
